The construction of One American Center was completed in 1984 and was developed by Rust Properties.  It was the tallest building in Austin until the finishing of the Frost Bank Tower in 2003. Established in 2012, the company is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.  The chairman is Anne Farlow.  The fund is managed by Bill Ackman of Pershing Square Capital Management.

One American Center | One American Center is a high-rise office building located at the northwest corner of West 6th Street and Congress Avenue in the Financial District of Downtown Austin, the state capital of Texas.  Standing 400 feet (122 meters) tall and containing 32 floors, it is currently the 11th tallest building in Austin. 271 North Avenue | 271 North Avenue (also known as the Schiff Building, Pershing Square, the Kaufman or K Building) is a 13 story art-deco office tower located in the downtown section of New Rochelle in Westchester County, New York.
Subway Terminal Building | The Subway Terminal Building, now Metro 417, is an Italian Renaissance Revival building in Downtown Los Angeles at 417 South Hill Street. Pershing Square, Manhattan | Pershing Square, in Manhattan, New York City, is the intersection of Park Avenue and 42nd Street in front of Grand Central Terminal.
